output.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at)::int AS creation_year, COUNT(*) AS accounts_created FROM marts.dim_customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
output.explanation: Counts rows in marts.dim_customers grouped by the calendar year of created_at (the account creation date). Each row is one customer account, so COUNT(*) gives the number of accounts created that year. No order status filter applies because the question is about account creation, not revenue.
